stem: Damini checks the even numbers $14$ and $18$ and asks whether their sum is a multiple of $4$.

options.text: $14$ and $18$ both leave remainder $2$ on division by $4$, so their sum $32$ is a multiple of $4$.
Every sum of two even numbers is a multiple of $4$, with no further check.
The same remainder rule also applies unchanged when one addend is odd.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Matching remainders $2$ and $2$ make $14+18=32$ a multiple of $4$; the check is on even addends with those remainders.

teacher.key_rationale: 14≡2 and 18≡2 (mod 4), so their sum 32 is a multiple of 4. Skipping the remainder check, or applying the rule to an odd addend, miss that condition.
